narrative: Key developments include Google integrating personalized Gemini AI into cars, SpaceX's AI business driving significant profits, and OpenAI expanding into life sciences. Infrastructure security is highlighted by Cloudflare's response to compromised eMudhra certificates and AWS introducing a new ECS Gateway. Space exploration continues with NASA's advancements in Mars helicopter blade designs, and significant progress is reported in quantum error correction.

highlights.title: Google’s more personalized Gemini AI is heading to your car
highlights.whyItMatters: Google is bringing Personal Intelligence to Gemini AI in your car.

highlights.title: SpaceX’s AI business is beating expectations
highlights.whyItMatters: SpaceX hit profitably in the third-quarter, with net income of $4.4 billion.

highlights.title: OpenAI acquires Orchestra Bio
highlights.whyItMatters: OpenAI is acquiring Orchestra Bio to bring AI-powered operations to life sciences R&D, helping biopharma teams accelerate drug development and advance new treatments.

highlights.title: US orders federal agencies to remove China’s DeepSeek AI from their systems
highlights.whyItMatters: The US has ordered federal civilian agencies to remove DeepSeek products and third-party services built using its technology, citing national security concerns.

highlights.title: 8 eMudhra certificates are compromised. Here's what you need to know
highlights.whyItMatters: Following the discovery that eight eMudhra intermediate certificates use weak keys, Cloudflare is deploying mitigations and releasing client updates.

highlights.title: Introducing Amazon ECS Gateway: A fully-managed ingress solution for ECS services
highlights.whyItMatters: Try Amazon ECS Gateway, a new account-level resource that simplifies ingress networking for containerized workloads by dynamically provisioning and managing the necessary infrastructure on your behalf, with all resources created directly in your account.

highlights.title: NASA Experimental Mars Helicopter Blade Designs Target Longer Flights
highlights.whyItMatters: NASA researchers are developing the future of flight on Mars, laying the groundwork for helicopters with the ability to fly higher and farther while conducting science on the Red Planet.

highlights.title: Quantum error correction goes well beyond breakeven
highlights.whyItMatters: A demo of error-corrected qubits shows big reductions in errors as they grow.
